Slow down, you move too fast


The Latino Newsletter (@LatNewsletter)

The April 27 edition of The Latino Newsletter is by @julito77 

Slowing Down, Always Forward
A startup journey update

thelatinonewsletter.org/p/sl…




— https://nitter.net/LatNewsletter/status/2048964213335277900#m
They should have fired the Marcelo Mayer Carshield commercial.

What Cora's IG posted last night, to the tune of Rubén Blades, "Amor y control."

Cuánto control y cuánto amor
Tiene que haber en una casa
Mucho control y mucho amor
Para enfrentar a la desgracia
Cora was not the reason why @RedSox started so horribly this year. 🇵🇷❤️

Feel bad for AC.


Jeff Passan (@JeffPassan)

The Boston Red Sox fired manager Alex Cora, hitting coach Peter Fatse, bench coach Rámon Vazquez and game-planning coach Jason Varitek, sources tell ESPN.

While the Red Sox won today, they are 10-17 and in last in the American League East. Massive change is coming in Boston.



— https://nitter.net/JeffPassan/status/2048174982509773120#m
I wonder how Trump/Puerto Rico statehood supporters are feeling today. Should we ask the governor of Puerto Rico, who is a Trump supporter and statehood proponent?
About Boston in the 70s and being the first Latino on local television, Jorge Quiroga said, "This was a city that was divided. A city that was eating itself."
"Being first does not matter unless you open the doors for others," Phyllis Barajas.
Such an inspiration to be sharing the same space today with Boston Latino LEGENDS. ❤️
A historic day for Massachusetts' Latino community. Such a privilege to be part of this convening.

Why am I @knicks fan?

Wrong answers only.
